Name: Sapling Revived
Author: silvermoonchan
Description:
[size=4]With permission from Robokit12, I've updated their mod [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/16814]Sapling - New NPC[/url] to 1.6![/size]

[size=4]Sapling is a sweet lil guy. He doesn't talk much, as he has no mouth (so don't give him cooked dishes, he won't appreciate it!) but he sees you working hard at restoring the Community Center and wants to help! So every once in a while, hell gift you a (vanilla) bundle item![/size]

[size=4]Sapling can be found around the Community Center usually frolicking with the wildlife or sometimes peeking out from his hide-hole in the ground. He has optional seasonal portraits and yes, he should be compatible with all major expansions![/size]

[size=4]Enjoy![/size]
